'''Fireheart''' is the name of [[Elayne Trakand]]'s horse.

==Appearance==
Fireheart is a tall, black gelding.

==Activities==
After [[Lioness]] is killed, Elayne acquires Fireheart from Master [[Hornwell]].{{ref/book|8|20}} Fireheart carries Elayne to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|8|28}} Fireheart is used by Elayne throughout several activities done by Elayne; riding through the streets of Caemlyn,{{ref/book|9|7}} meeting with the [[Borderland]]er rulers,{{ref/book|9|27}} returning from [[House Matherin]],{{ref/book|10|10}} and defending Caemlyn's walls from an attack from [[Arymilla Marne]].{{ref/book|11|13}} Fireheart is also riden by Elayne when she is captured by the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|11|31}}
